Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current or future periods

WEALTH MANAGEMENT FEES - Growth in new accounts and higher mineral fee income linked to oil and gas prices boosted wealth management fee income
MORTGAGE INCOME DECLINE - Mortgage income fell as volume and margins were impacted by spike in long term rates
